description: This file is a shell script used for controlling and managing the status LEDs on a device. It provides functions to identify the power and fault LEDs and sets their states based on different system stages such as preinit, failsafe, upgrade, and done.

methods.name: get_status_led
methods.description: Finds and returns the name of the power status LED device.

methods.name: get_failsafe_led
methods.description: Finds and returns the name of the fault LED device.

methods.name: set_state
methods.description: Sets the LED states based on the provided system state parameter.
parameters: $1: system state (preinit, failsafe, preinit_regular, upgrade, done)
